patch_description:
This crossover keeps the stronger active-triple guided mutations and occasional coupled moves from the inspiration program, while retaining the phase-dependent merit smoothing and tolerant polishing behavior from the current version.

The search is made more efficient by caching determinant values for the incumbent state. Each annealing iteration now computes determinants only for the proposed candidate, rather than repeatedly recomputing them for merit evaluation and active-triple selection. The SLSQP Jacobian is also assembled vectorially, reducing local-polish overhead while preserving the same signed maximin formulation and deterministic seed.
